name: Annelieke Vermeer
bio:
Annelieke's motorsport journey began with a childhood obsession for Formula 1, fueled by her father's engineering background. After graduating with honors in mechanical engineering from Delft University of Technology, she quickly immersed herself in the world of racing. Starting as a data analyst for a small Formula Ford team, she proved her worth through meticulous analysis and innovative problem-solving. This led to roles with increasing responsibility, culminating in her current position as Chief Engineer for FVee Brasil.

Annelieke is known for her rigorous and data-driven approach. She believes in pushing the limits of existing technology while maintaining a strong emphasis on reliability and safety. Her ability to quickly diagnose issues and develop effective solutions has earned her respect within the paddock. However, she also has a reputation for being demanding, expecting the same level of commitment and attention to detail from her team that she demands of herself.

What sets Annelieke apart is her passion for innovation. She is constantly seeking new ways to improve performance, whether it's through optimizing existing systems or exploring cutting-edge technologies. This drive, combined with her experience and expertise, makes her a valuable asset to any team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, often pulled back into a practical ponytail
physical.description: Annelieke is of average height with a focused, intense gaze and a no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on a perfectly organized workspace, down to the precise placement of her tools.
